# Recipe: Draft Email from Doc

💳 Curated by Skill Harbor — a gws recipe: pull the text of a Google Doc and use it as the body of a Gmail message — handy for newsletters, announcements, or any message drafted collaboratively in Docs. Composes two utility skills (gws-docs + gws-gmail), which must be loaded first. Requires the gws CLI and a paid Google Workspace account — there is no free tier for this CLI. By @googleworkspace, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: it sends a real email — check the rendered body before sending; formatting is carried over as text from the Doc; gws-shared must be read first for auth and global flags. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
